name: Bajra Na Rotla with White Butter
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the bajra flour and a pinch of salt.
2. Gradually add warm water and knead well to form a soft, smooth dough.
3. Take a small portion of the dough and shape it into a ball, then flatten it into a thick disc using your palms and fingertips.
4. Heat a heavy-bottomed tava (griddle) over medium-high heat.
5. Place the rotla on the hot tava and cook until bubbles form on the surface.
6. Flip carefully and cook the other side until golden brown spots appear, ensuring it is cooked through.
7. Serve hot topped with a generous dollop of fresh white butter.
description: A staple rustic dish widely consumed in the rural belts of Dadra and Nagar Haveli. These thick, nutritious millet rotis are highly valued for their health benefits and are traditionally paired with white butter to provide energy, reflecting the agrarian culture of the region.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
